task.title: Unify service health readiness and observability surfaces
task.summary_zh: 把 service health/observability 從 baseline 混用 /health、/__health__ 提升到一致的 /healthz、/livez、/readyz 與基本 metrics/status contract，同時保留舊路由相容。
acceptance: every default and newly materialized service exposes healthz livez and readyz with consistent JSON shape
legacy health and __health__ routes remain compatibility aliases or documented exceptions
compose healthchecks and smoke tests use the standardized readiness path
baseline observability includes dependency status and minimal metrics or status endpoint where applicable
tests verify healthy degraded and dependency failure states
task.next: Owner finalized approved health/readiness observability unification and closed the task after Codex review approval.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：health helper 統一 /healthz、/livez、/readyz、/metrics JSON shape，包含 service_up metrics，dependency degraded/error/unavailable/failed 會讓 /readyz 回 503。
compose 與 honest smoke 已改用 /readyz；舊 /health 或 /__health__ 路由在 reviewed services 保留相容，外部 MinIO probe 維持 provider-specific /healthz。
驗證完成：focused health/compose tests 15 passed、py_compile 使用暫存 pycache 通過、docker-compose YAML parse 與 docker compose config 通過、task-scoped git diff --check 通過。

handoffs.message: Health observability unification ready for review: standard health payload now includes service_up metrics; compose external probe typos corrected; honest smoke now defines and waits for research-worker-gateway /readyz. Verified focused health tests, compose activation tests, service-family contract, py_compile, yaml parse, and docker compose config.

Codex review approved: standardized health/readiness observability surfaces are wired through helper routes, compose/smoke readiness checks use /readyz, legacy aliases remain compatible, and focused verification passed. Owner should finalize to done.
